provenance.title: Monitoring Metrics Related to the Global Covid-19 Vaccination Strategy in a Changing World

candidates.statement: Monitoring metrics The following metrics are recommended for the global community to measure and monitor progress in support of the strategic goals (see table 1).
Countries are recommended to continue reporting data at least monthly for metrics 1-4, and annually for metric 6.

2 • Number of older adults vaccinated with a complete primary series by country • Number of older persons vaccinated with at least one booster/additional dose by country • Definition of ‘older population’ age group by country8 • Regional systems based on country reports • Total number of older adults, aggregated by age based on country- specific definition of older population • United Nations population estimates9 3 • Number of persons vaccinated with a complete primary series by country • Number of persons vaccinated with at least one booster/additional dose by country • Regional systems based on country reports • Total population by country • United Nations population estimates 4 • Areas with people in need of humanitarian assistance • Global Humanitarian Overview, defined by The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)10 • Total number of people living in areas with people in need of humanitarian assistance • Multiple sources, as collated by the UN (WHO) Global Health Cluster11 5 The WHO will define a data collection mechanism in the second half of 2022 6 • Proxy metric12 • WHO And UNICEF ’s annual eJRF13 • Supplementary information provided by c
